notes.title: Minor Gameplay Adjustments and Bug Fixes Update Log - 2025.09.14 v1.0.4A
notes.content:
Good Sunday, Your Majesty. We have implemented some further updates and fixes to the game. Details are as follows:
[olist]
Bug fixes.

The effect of the "Celestial Mandate" event will now be removed upon entering Endless Mode.

Slightly increased clearance rewards on certain difficulty levels.

Added a new low-difficulty mode, accessible via the leftmost button in the difficulty tab on the mode selection screen.

Adjusted certain sound effects.
[/olist][p align="start"]Happy weekend!

notes.title: Minor Gameplay Adjustments and Bug Fixes Update Log - 2025.09.13 v1.03B
notes.content:
Good afternoon, Your Majesty. We have implemented further updates and fixes to the game. Details are as follows:
[olist]
Bug fixes.

Changed the numerical color of card corner icons—each stacking value now has a unique color indicator.

Reduced the difficulty of certain crisis challenges.

Adjusted the appearance rates of certain cards and policies—higher-quality cards and policies are now more likely to appear.

Added additional sound effects.
[/olist][p align="start"]We hope you enjoy the game! You are also cordially invited to join our Discord to discuss court affairs together!

notes.title: Your Kingdom Awaits. 'It's time,your majesty' Launches Sept 11
notes.content:
Your Majesty, we have great news!
"It's time,your majesty" has officially announced its release date—it will launch on Steam on September 11, priced at 5.99$!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186847/69dc19d7b46706a94352dcbe102ee6b23fd14f77.jpg"]

As the ruler of a nation, you must recruit talents, muster troops, and defend against the invasion of the Xiongnu. Alternatively, you can formulate policies to strengthen the economy. When the national granary’s surplus can match the strength of foreign threats, the people will live in peace, and the realm will thrive!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186847/f11aa5e191c17b2570fdf704aa9426e3ac3b3bea.png"]



At times, random events may catch you off guard—stay vigilant against plagues or locust disasters, adjust your governance strategies, and strive to weather each natural or man-made catastrophe. Managing a vast empire is no easy task, but wisely employing "reforms" or changing the zodiac of the era may just help you turn the tide and usher in a new dawn.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186847/454992bd4bb2308b649a466e84a467460410ce3f.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186847/47dca6c24685adca7c924cf70ed9e81e197736d3.png"]
